candidate_policy: Choose existing, historically observed entities before executing labels; ten distinct entities per parent question; no label balancing and no replacement after censoring.
original_qa_split_kind: grouped stratified question split, not a chronological split of original prediction labels
prediction_training_policy: Train on support/train, select on support/validation, and keep original qa/test as the current main test. Revised support/test is reserved for separate final evaluation, never per-query adaptation.
test_support_policy: Final temporal evaluation instances only; not adaptation data. Existing qa/test remains the current experiment cohort.
snapshot_assumptions: Rows and labels are verified against the supplied database snapshot; independent event ingestion histories are unavailable.
Order items and payments inherit their parent order purchase time for historical visibility.
Review creation determines the target window; review answer time is also required for label availability.
Unversioned entity attributes are snapshot attributes; the historical view suppresses final order status and future actual lifecycle dates but cannot reconstruct unrecorded attribute revisions.
